title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**About the role**

**Let’s {code} the together at {Tesco Technology}!**

**Job Description**

As a
**React Native Software Development Engineer**
, you’ll be working in an agile team of industry leading engineers upon Tesco’s customer facing mobile application. Working with Product Managers, you will be responsible for the future direction of the products that we build, solving problems and developing new features through quality, scalable, performant and maintainable technical solutions. The solutions that you will be responsible for will have a global reach, impacting millions of customers.

You’ll be a passionate, pragmatic React Native Software Development Engineer with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and most importantly put our customer first. You’ll enjoy working as part of a team and be a keen problem solver. Comfortable with modern engineering practices and mobile development tooling and technologies you’ll use innovation to improve the customer experience and efficiency of engineering teams.

**You will be responsible for**
Qualifications and relevant experience for this job
  
We are looking for people who have a passion for Technology. You will likely have made open-source contributions and have a GitHub account. You will demonstrate experience of different platforms and technologies. We expect to see some or all the following:
  
Experience in architecting complex mobile applications
  
Extensive experience working on commercial software development in React Native
  
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent
  
Firm understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of mobile platforms
  
Passion for mobile development. We would love to hear about apps you’ve developed.
  
Understanding and exposure to integrating GraphQL API endpoints
  
Strong experience and understanding of industry standard mobile accessibility
  
Experience in full development life cycle; design, coding, test, build, QA, deployment, and maintenance
  
Exposure to the DevOps model
  
Experience in Lean and Agile environments and understanding of principles behind methodologies such as: BDD, ATDD and TDD
  
A strong team player with the ability to influence and lead stakeholders when necessary
  
Demonstrable ability to self-manage, be proactive, take ownership, build relationships, and drive solutions through from inception to production
  
  
  
  
**You will need**
What will you do?
  
You will be working on the Tesco UK mobile application to implement the capabilities to improve and personalize customer experience and ease of use in the store. In this team we use the latest technologies, working with a GraphQL backend (maintained by another team). This squad of 7 will have both Android and iOS developers and you will work closely with our other native development and platform teams to deliver a high-quality product.
  
We love to work with smart people who have a strong sense of ownership and strong engineering mindset.
  
You provide mobile perspective and context for technology choices.
  
You’re up to the challenge of device and mobile network limitations, device fragmentation, and other mobile development curve balls.
  
You are motivated to tackle ambiguous situations with new technologies to rapidly produce prototypes.
  
You outline paths from prototype to product.
  
You are a technical leader for your team. You contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices on your team.
  
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Backend & Infrastructure
description:
**Company Description**
FilterPixel is a reliability-first system built to support high-volume event photography under real-world pressure, tight timelines, and large crowds. The platform solves key pain points for photographers, event teams, and sponsors by transforming thousands of photos into structured, usable content. FilterPixel Studio enables fast, high-quality selections, on-the-fly editing, and same-day delivery for photographers. FilterPixel Live gives attendees instant photo access, brand-safe sponsor-ready galleries, and integrated social media engagement with measurable ROI. The team partners closely with conference organizers, corporate event teams, and high-volume photographers to build production-ready systems that consistently perform at scale.

**Role Description**
This full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer — Backend & Infrastructure role focuses on designing, building, and maintaining the backend systems that power FilterPixel Studio and FilterPixel Live. Responsibilities include developing scalable APIs and services, optimizing data pipelines and storage, and improving reliability and performance for high-volume image processing and delivery. The role involves collaborating with product and frontend teams to define technical requirements, implement secure integrations, and ensure system resilience under heavy load. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation, monitoring, and incident response, as well as code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring other engineers. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex backend challenges and building robust systems that support demanding real-time event workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and systems design.
* Proficiency in Back-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining production services.
* Advanced Programming skills and hands-on expertise with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
* Experience designing scalable, secure APIs and distributed systems for high-traffic or high-volume applications.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code or automation tools.
* Familiarity with databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching, and message queues for performance and reliability.
* Strong debugging, monitoring, and observability skills, including logging, metrics, and alerting practices.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote, distributed team.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in media processing, event-tech, or real-time systems is a plus.

title: AI Engineer | India
description:
AI Engineer | India

**Department:**
Engineering 
  
  
**Reports To:**
Product & Engineering Leadership 
  
  
**Location:**
India - Fully Remote 
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time 
  
  
**Experience Level:**
Mid-Level 
  
  
**Compensation:**
₹15,00,000 - ₹22,00,000 per year (15-22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 

**Position Overview**

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy production-ready Generative AI and LLM-powered applications, including RAG systems, AI assistants, intelligent automation tools, and agentic workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong Python skills and practical experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, AI APIs, and modern AI frameworks. The AI Engineer will work closely with engineering, product, operations, and leadership teams to deliver scalable AI solutions for global clients. 

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI System Development**

* Design, build, and deploy production-ready Generative AI and LLM-powered applications.

* Develop chatbots, copilots, intelligent automation tools, and AI-assisted workflows.

* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector search, and structured or unstructured data.

* Integrate LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and similar providers.

* Develop backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.

* Design prompts, system instructions, and context-management strategies to improve model performance and reliability.

* Build scalable AI services that can move from prototypes into production.

**Production & Optimization**

* Evaluate LLM outputs and improve quality, accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost.

* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize deployed AI systems.

* Work with vector databases and search technologies for semantic retrieval and knowledge-based applications.

* Implement appropriate evaluation, validation, guardrails, and error-handling strategies.

* Identify and resolve production issues and system regressions.

**Collaboration & Innovation**

* Partner with engineering, product, operations, and business teams to translate requirements into practical AI solutions.

* Contribute to architecture decisions, technical discussions, and documentation.

* Stay current with developments in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, and emerging AI tooling.

* Evaluate and implement new AI models, frameworks, and techniques where appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years**
  of software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or related development experience.

* Strong proficiency in Python.

* Practical experience building applications using LLMs.

* Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.

* Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.

* Understanding of prompt engineering, model behavior, context management, and LLM evaluation.

* Experience developing APIs or backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git, REST APIs, testing, debugging, and system design.

* Familiarity with Docker and modern development practices.

* Ability to take an AI use case from requirements through development, testing, and deployment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and written/verbal English communication.

* Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building production AI copilots, chatbots, agents, or intelligent automation systems.

* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.

* Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, Chroma, or similar vector databases.

* Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and multi-step AI systems.

* Experience with LLM fine-tuning, LoRA, or similar techniques.

* Experience deploying AI applications in AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Familiarity with model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.

* Experience with SQL, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or model-serving infrastructure.

**Working Relationships**

The AI Engineer will collaborate with:

* Engineering leadership and product teams.

* Software engineers and backend developers.

* Global AI research and development teams.

* Product, operations, and business stakeholders.

**Success in This Role**

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models.

You should be able to:

* Build and deploy practical Generative AI and LLM applications.

* Demonstrate real-world experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, and LLM APIs.

* Explain the architecture and technical decisions behind your work.

* Translate emerging AI technologies into practical engineering solutions.

* Improve AI system quality, reliability, latency, and cost.

* Work effectively with distributed global teams and adapt to evolving priorities.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.**

* Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.

* **90-day probationary period.**

* Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:

* Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.

* Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.

* Career growth and professional development opportunities.

**Work Environment**

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 
  
 

**Required Work Schedule**

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM-4:00 PM Pacific Time (PT).

For team members based in India, this is an overnight schedule and will generally correspond to approximately 7:30 PM-4:30 AM IST or 8:30 PM-5:30 AM IST, depending on U.S. daylight saving time.

The ability to consistently work the full Pacific Time schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours in India and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to the nature of AI engineering work, project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities may occasionally require weekend availability or schedule adjustments. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard weekly schedule, but flexibility to support business needs when required is an expectation of the role. 

**Our Hiring Process**

**1. Initial Recruiter Screening**
An introductory video call to discuss your experience, career goals, salary expectations, and the role.

**2. Practical Skills Assessment**
A take-home assessment evaluating technical knowledge, problem-solving, and your approach to a real-world Generative AI/LLM engineering scenario.

**3. Assessment Review**
Our team will evaluate your submission based on technical approach, architecture, implementation, and production readiness.

**4. Technical Interview**

A technical interview focused on your coding skills, technical knowledge, problem-solving abilities, and experience with Generative AI/LLM engineering.

**5. Final Interview - CTO**

A technical discussion focused on your assessment, architectural thinking, problem-solving, Generative AI/LLM experience, and overall alignment with the role.

title: TPU Kernel Optimization & Performance Engineering Expert (Freelance)
description:
**Engagement Overview**

This role focuses on accelerating the performance, portability, and numerical correctness of cutting-edge machine learning workloads on
**Google TPUs**
. You will work across high-level ML frameworks, compiler/runtime systems, distributed execution environments, and low-level custom kernels to eliminate hardware bottlenecks and implement ultra-efficient workloads.

The ideal candidate operates seamlessly between model-level math and hardware-aware execution: inspecting GPU-oriented implementations, analyzing their exact semantics, translating them into TPU-compatible forms, and rigorously validating both numerical correctness and execution speed.

Key Responsibilities

* **Kernel Development & Porting:**
  Develop and optimize high-performance custom kernels and critical ML operations for TPU execution. Translate CUDA and Triton kernel behaviors into standard PyTorch or JAX implementations that compile efficiently via OpenXLA/XLA.
* **Workload Profiling & Diagnostics:**
  Profile distributed training and inference workloads to identify compute, memory, communication, compilation, and data-movement bottlenecks.
* **Full-Stack Debugging:**
  Debug correctness and performance issues across ML frameworks, compiler/runtime layers, distributed execution topologies, and accelerator kernels.
* **Adversarial Agent Benchmarking & Task Formulation:**
  Design authentic, production-derived engineering challenges from modern open-weight architectures (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) to stress-test and evaluate baseline frontier models (e.g., Gemini 3.7 Flash, Claude Code), establishing ground-truth solutions and rigorous evaluation rubrics for autonomous agents.
* **Hardware-Aware Strategy:**
  Design TPU-friendly tiling, sharding, reduction, data-movement, and mixed-precision strategies for standard and custom ML operations.
* **Correctness & Gradient Validation:**
  Validate numerical equivalence, gradient correctness, masking/indexing behavior, and edge cases between source GPU implementations and TPU-targeted implementations.
* **Benchmark Architecture:**
  Build and maintain diagnostic workflows and reproducible microbenchmarks to measure latency, throughput, utilization, memory usage, communication overhead, and performance regressions.
* **Frontier Model Optimization:**
  Analyze transformer and LLM workloads—including attention variants, MoE, KV-cache, quantized matmuls, and distributed training/serving patterns—to capture performance gains.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Collaborate with ML systems, compiler, infrastructure, and model engineers to translate workload requirements into efficient accelerator implementations.

Minimum Qualifications

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Systems Programming:**
  Strong programming proficiency in Python and at least one systems language (
  **C++, CUDA, or Pallas**
  ).
* **Accelerator Frameworks:**
  Hands-on experience developing and optimizing ML accelerator code using
  **JAX/Pallas, PyTorch-XLA, or OpenXLA**
  .
* **Distributed ML:**
  Practical understanding of distributed machine learning concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Advanced Degree:**
  Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* **TPU Hardware Knowledge:**
  In-depth knowledge of TPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and hardware performance characteristics.
* **GPU-to-TPU Translation:**
  Proven experience converting CUDA or Triton implementations to standard PyTorch or JAX APIs for TPU execution while maintaining numerical and gradient semantics.
* **Distributed Collectives & Parallelism:**
  Strong background in distributed ML techniques, including data, tensor, sequence, and expert parallelism; multidimensional sharding; and collective communications (all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter, all-to-all).
* **Frontier Model Profiling:**
  Experience extracting, profiling, and optimizing kernels from frontier open-weight models (e.g., DeepSeek V3/V4, Qwen 2.5/3.8, Kimi K2.5).
* **Numerical Stability & Precision:**
  Deep experience debugging numerical correctness issues involving bf16/fp32 accumulation, quantization scaling, softmax/log-sum-exp stability, masking, and backward-pass gradient behavior.
* **High-Performance ML Stacks:**
  Experience with performance-oriented open-source systems such as vLLM, FlashAttention, JAX/Flax, PyTorch/XLA, or equivalent kernel libraries.
* **Benchmarking & Tooling:**
  Experience designing reproducible microbenchmarks, performance regression test suites, and profiling tools for accelerator workloads.

Engagement Details

* **Engagement Type:**
  Independent Freelance Contract
* **Location:**
  100% Remote (India)

title: Lead Engineer – UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems
description:
Lead Engineer – UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems
  
  
INFOCORP® | Aerospace Research & Advanced Navigation Technologies
  
  
Employment: Full-time | On-site
  
Location: Bengaluru / Ernakulam, India
  
Experience: Minimum 7 years
  
Category: UAV Systems · Aerospace Engineering · Technical Leadership
  
Status: Immediate Opening | Featured
  
  
About INFOCORP®
  
  
INFOCORP® (Infocorp Fleet Management Solutions Private Limited) is an Indian research and engineering organisation advancing aerospace navigation and positioning technologies.
  
  
Our activities encompass UAV and autonomous aerial systems, GNSS-supported navigation, and research into navigation resilience in environments where satellite-based positioning may be degraded or unavailable.
  
  
We are expanding our engineering capabilities to develop, integrate and validate next-generation aerospace navigation technologies through rigorous research and practical engineering.
  
  
Role Description
  
  
We are seeking an accomplished, hands-on Lead Engineer – UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems to lead the development and integration of UAV navigation technologies and associated aerospace engineering systems.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a central role in establishing and strengthening our engineering capabilities, translating technical objectives into executable development activities, and leading multidisciplinary engineering efforts towards functioning, demonstrable systems.
  
  
This position requires practical engineering experience, sound technical judgement, proven system-delivery capabilities and the ability to lead engineers across multiple disciplines.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Lead UAV navigation and aerospace systems engineering activities, from requirements definition through development, integration and validation.
  
- Develop and evaluate system architectures involving navigation sensors, flight controllers, embedded systems, software and communication interfaces.
  
- Guide engineering activities involving GNSS navigation, inertial sensing, sensor fusion and real-time localisation.
  
- Coordinate multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to engineering team development.
  
- Establish structured engineering workflows, design reviews, technical documentation and verification procedures.
  
- Plan and supervise simulation, hardware integration, laboratory evaluation and field-testing activities.
  
- Assess engineering alternatives, investigate technical challenges and recommend practical solutions.
  
- Translate research objectives into measurable development milestones and functioning technology demonstrations.
  
- Report technical progress, engineering risks, resource requirements and development outcomes to management.
  
  
Essential Qualifications and Experience
  
  
- A degree in Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, Electronics, Robotics, Computer Science or a related discipline, or comparable demonstrable engineering experience.
  
- At least seven years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on involvement with UAVs, autonomous platforms, navigation systems or closely related technologies.
  
- Demonstrated experience developing, integrating or delivering functioning UAV or autonomous-system technologies.
  
- Strong understanding of GNSS-based navigation, inertial sensors, embedded systems and system integration.
  
- Practical experience with flight controllers and programming using C/C++ or Python.
  
- Working knowledge of navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, state estimation or real-time localisation.
  
- Experience leading technical development, resolving integration challenges and coordinating engineering activities.
  
- Ability to produce and review engineering documentation, assess technical risks and communicate complex engineering matters clearly.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  
- UAV manufacturing, aerospace systems integration, autonomous robotics or navigation technology development.
  
- Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, ROS, MATLAB/Simulink or comparable engineering environments.
  
- Hardware-in-the-loop simulation, structured verification, system testing or flight-test activities.
  
- Experience with safety-critical engineering, reliability assessments or aerospace verification practices.
  
- Exposure to advanced navigation research, alternative positioning techniques or emerging sensing technologies.
  
- Experience establishing engineering teams, laboratory capabilities or early-stage technology development activities.
  
  
What Makes This Role Distinctive
